question: Which wallets accumulated the most $SQD across Arbitrum and Base in the last month (net new)?

definitions.SQD: The SQD token at 0x1337420ded5adb9980cfc35f8f2b054ea86f8ab1 on Arbitrum and 0xd4554bea546efa83c1e6b389ecac40ea999b3e78 on Base, 18 decimals each, from Portal's token list
definitions.wallet: Any address that sent or received SQD, contracts included. The zero address is left out, since mints come from it and burns go to it
definitions.net new: SQD the address received minus SQD it sent in the window, from the token's Transfer logs, added up over both chains by address

alternatives: Count only wallets without code, leaving out pools, bridges, exchanges and staking contracts
The last 30 days (2026-10-05 to 2026-11-04) instead of the calendar month
Rank each chain on its own instead of adding the chains up
Count SQD received, ignoring what each address sent

results.sql:
-- The address that gained the most SQD over October 2026 on Arbitrum and Base together: SQD received
-- minus SQD sent, the zero address left out. sqd_net_accumulators_by_wallet ranks every address with the
-- same window and tokens.
with sqd as (
    select from_address, to_address, value
    from "warehouse"."analytics"."erc20_transfers"
    where (
        chain = 'arbitrum'
        and token = '0x1337420ded5adb9980cfc35f8f2b054ea86f8ab1'
        and block_number between 510496864 and 520129273
    ) or (
        chain = 'base'
        and token = '0xd4554bea546efa83c1e6b389ecac40ea999b3e78'
        and block_number between 52011727 and 53350926
    )
),

flows as (
    select to_address as address, value as net from sqd
    union all
    select from_address as address, -value as net from sqd
)

select address as top_accumulator
from flows
where address <> '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000'
group by address
order by sum(net) desc, address
limit 1

-- Each address's net SQD over October 2026 on Arbitrum and Base: SQD received minus SQD sent, per chain
-- and added up over both, most first. The zero address is left out: mints come from it and burns go to
-- it. The blocks are October 2026 UTC on each chain, from answers/sqd-net-accumulators/question.yaml.
with sqd as (
    select chain, from_address, to_address, value
    from "warehouse"."analytics"."erc20_transfers"
    where (
        chain = 'arbitrum'
        and token = '0x1337420ded5adb9980cfc35f8f2b054ea86f8ab1'
        and block_number between 510496864 and 520129273
    ) or (
        chain = 'base'
        and token = '0xd4554bea546efa83c1e6b389ecac40ea999b3e78'
        and block_number between 52011727 and 53350926
    )
),

flows as (
    select chain, to_address as address, value as received, 0 as sent, 1 as transfers_in, 0 as transfers_out
    from sqd

    union all

    select chain, from_address as address, 0 as received, value as sent, 0 as transfers_in, 1 as transfers_out
    from sqd
)

select
    address,
    round(sum(received - sent) / 1e18, 6) as net_sqd,
    round(sum(received - sent) filter (where chain = 'arbitrum') / 1e18, 6) as arbitrum_net_sqd,
    round(sum(received - sent) filter (where chain = 'base') / 1e18, 6) as base_net_sqd,
    round(sum(received) / 1e18, 6) as received_sqd,
    round(sum(sent) / 1e18, 6) as sent_sqd,
    sum(transfers_in) as transfers_in,
    sum(transfers_out) as transfers_out
from flows
where address <> '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000'
group by address
order by sum(received - sent) desc, address
